calls.statement: SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date = CURRENT_DATE
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year FROM ref_fiscal_calendar ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_period = 3 ORDER BY fiscal_year

SELECT 
  SUM(fsl.quantity) AS total_units,
  dd.fiscal_year
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE ds.store_id = 108
  AND dp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
  AND dp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 3
  AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
GROUP BY dd.fiscal_year

-- Verify the final answer with detailed breakdown
SELECT 
  ds.store_id,
  ds.store_name,
  dd.fiscal_year,
  dd.fiscal_period,
  rfc.period_start_date,
  rfc.period_end_date,
  SUM(fsl.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
INNER JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar rfc ON dd.fiscal_year = rfc.fiscal_year AND dd.fiscal_period = rfc.fiscal_period
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE ds.store_id = 108
  AND dp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 3
  AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
GROUP BY ds.store_id, ds.store_name, dd.fiscal_year, dd.fiscal_period, rfc.period_start_date, rfc.period_end_date
